PraisonAI Gateway WebSocket /ws and agent topology /info endpoints have no authentication. Any network client can connect, enumerate agents, and send arbitrary messages to agents and tools.

/config/update endpoint lacks admin role authorization. Authenticated user can modify proxy config, register custom pass-through handlers to attacker-controlled Python code (RCE), read server files, and take over admin accounts.

When JWT auth enabled, OIDC userinfo cache uses token[:20] as key. Identical JWT header prefixes from same algorithm produce cache collisions. Unauthenticated attacker crafts token matching legit user's cache prefix, inheriting identity and permissions.
Claude Code on Windows loads managed-settings.json from C:\ProgramData\ClaudeCode\ without validating directory ownership. Low-privileged user can pre-create directory with malicious config for LPE.
